meta.association: IL2RA encodes CD25, the alpha chain of the interleukin-2 receptor. Reported disease alleles are germline biallelic loss-of-function variants (frameshift, splice-site, multi-exon deletion and missense) that abolish or prevent surface expression of the chain, so the gene-disease relationship is causative with an autosomal recessive loss-of-function mechanism. Common non-coding IL2RA regulatory polymorphisms are susceptibility alleles for type 1 diabetes and multiple sclerosis; those are a separate, polygenic relationship and are deliberately not curated here.
